by_provider.NASA EMIT: 11 plume complexes (locations only — set EARTHDATA_TOKEN for emission rates)

association_note: Distance to the nearest mapped infrastructure. Proximity is not attribution — it indicates what is nearby, not what emitted.
rate_note: Each rate is an instantaneous snapshot at one overpass, in kg/hr. These must never be summed across plumes or extrapolated to annual totals: detections span several years, sample different moments, and are biased toward large, detectable events.
